translations.text: Blessed is the man who did not walk in the counsel of the ungodly, did not stand in the way of sinners, and did not sit in the seat of the wicked.
Instead, his delight is in the law of the Lord, and he shall meditate on his law day and night.
He shall be like a tree planted beside streams of water, which gives its fruit in season, and its leaves shall not fall. Everything he does shall prosper.
Not so are the ungodly, not so! They are like dust that the wind blows across the face of the earth.
Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
For the Lord knows the ways of the righteous, but the ways of the ungodly shall perish.
Without a heading. In the Hebrew Scriptures, these two are counted as one.
Why did the nations rage, and the peoples plot vain things?
The kings of the earth took their stand, and the rulers gathered together against the Lord and against his Anointed.
Let us break their bonds and cast their yoke away from us.
He who dwells in heaven shall laugh at them, and the Lord shall scorn them.
Then he shall speak to them in his anger and terrify them in his wrath.
I was appointed king by him over Zion, his holy mountain, to proclaim the commands of the Lord.
The Lord said to me, “You are my Son, and today I have begotten you.
Ask of me, and I shall give you the nations as an inheritance, and dominion over all the ends of the earth.
You shall rule them with an iron rod; you shall shatter them like a potter’s vessel.”
Now, kings, take this to heart; accept instruction, all you who judge the earth.
Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice before him with trembling.
Accept his instruction, lest the Lord become angry and you perish from the paths of righteousness
when his anger blazes up. Blessed are all who have put their hope in the Lord.
A psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom.
Lord, how numerous my oppressors have become! Many have risen against me.
Many said of me, “There is no salvation for him with his God.”
But you, Lord, are my helper, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
I cried to the Lord with my voice, and he heard me from his holy mountain.
I lay down and slept; I awoke, and the Lord sustains me.
I shall not fear the tens of thousands of their troops who kept me surrounded and besieged on every side.
Arise, Lord, and save me, my God, for you have struck all who were hostile to me without cause, and you will shatter the teeth of sinners.
Salvation belongs to the Lord; your blessing is upon your people.
For the end, for praise. A psalm of David.
When I called, you heard me, God, according to righteousness. In my distress you gave me relief. Have mercy on me and hear my prayers.
Children of humanity, how long will you be hard-hearted? Why do you love vanity and seek falsehood?
Know that the Lord has done wonderful things for his holy one, and the Lord will hear me when I call to him.
Be angry, but do not sin. Repent of whatever you say in your hearts while on your beds.
Offer sacrifices of righteousness and put your hope in the Lord.
Many were saying, “Who will show us good things?” The light of your face has been made manifest to us.
And you gave joy to our hearts; you filled them with the produce of their grain, wine, and oil.
In peace, in this and in the same [?], we will sleep and wake.
For you alone, Lord, have made us dwell apart, with hope in you.
For the end, concerning those who receive an inheritance. A psalm of David.
Listen to my words, Lord, and take heed of my cry.
Attend to the sound of my prayers, my King and my God.
I plead with you, Lord. In the morning you will hear my voice; in the morning I will prepare to appear before you.
For you are not a God who desires lawlessness, nor do evil people dwell with you.
Let no lawless people dwell before your eyes. You have hated those who practice lawlessness.
You destroy all who speak lies; you, Lord, abhor the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
But I, according to your abundant mercy, will enter your house and bow down toward your holy temple in fear of you.
Lord, lead me in your righteousness because of my enemies; make your path straight before me.
For there is no truth in their mouths, and their hearts are empty. Their throat is like an open grave; with their tongues they have practiced deceit.
Judge them, God, so that they fall through their own schemes. Cast them out because of their great wickedness, for they have provoked you.
Let all who have put their hope in you rejoice; let them exult forever, and you will dwell among them. Let those who love your name boast in you.
For you will bless the righteous, Lord; you have surrounded them with your favor as with a shield.
For the end, with praise, concerning the eighth. A psalm of David.
Lord, do not rebuke me in your indignation or discipline me in your anger.
Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am sick. Heal my soul, for my bones are troubled.
My soul is greatly troubled. And you, Lord—how long?
Turn, Lord, and rescue my soul; save me, Lord, according to your mercy.
For no one remembers you in death, nor does anyone give thanks to you in Hades.
I have grown weary with my groaning. Every night I wash my bed and soak my couch with my tears.
My eye is troubled by anger; I have wasted away because of all my enemies.
Depart from me, all you who practice lawlessness. The Lord has heard the sound of my weeping.
The Lord has heard my prayers, and the Lord has accepted my requests.
Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled; let them turn back and be deeply ashamed at once, and let them be troubled.
A psalm of David, which he spoke to the Lord concerning the words of Cush, son of Jemini.
Lord my God, I have put my hope in you. Save me from all who pursue me, and deliver me.
Otherwise he may seize my soul like a lion, with no one to rescue me and no one to deliver me.
Lord my God, if I have done this, if there is wrongdoing in my hands,
if I have ever repaid with evil those who repaid me, may I too fall helpless before my enemies.
Then let the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it; let him trample my life into the earth and lay my glory in the dust.
Arise, Lord, in your anger, and rise up to bring my enemies to an end. Awake, Lord my God, for the commands you have given.
And let the assemblies of the peoples gather around you; for their sake, return to the heights, Lord.
And the Lord judges his people. Judge me, Lord, according to my righteousness and according to the innocence that is in me.
Let evils come to an end upon sinners, and grant success to the righteous, you righteous God who examines hearts and kidneys.
My help rightly comes from God, who saves those who are upright in heart.
God is a righteous judge, mighty and patient, who does not bring his anger upon us every day.
But if he does not turn back to him, he has sharpened his sword and drawn his bow.
And with him the weapons of death are prepared, and he has made his arrows fiery.
Look, he labored to bring forth lawlessness; he conceived pain and gave birth to injustice.
The pit that he dug and hollowed out—he will fall into that very chasm that he made.
Let his troubles return upon his own head, and let his wrongdoing descend upon his own crown.
I will give thanks to the Lord according to his righteousness, and I will sing a psalm to the name of the Lord Most High.
For the end. On the winepresses. A psalm of David.
Lord, our Lord, how wonderful is your name throughout the earth! Your majesty has been exalted above the heavens.
From the mouths of children, infants, and nursing babies you have established praise because of your enemies, Lord, so that the enemy and the adversary may be destroyed.
I will look at the heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars that you established.
What is a human being that you remember him, or a son of man that you should care for him?
You made him a little lower than your angels; you crowned him with glory and honor.
You set him over everything made by your hands; you put all things under his feet.
The sheep and cattle, and everything else, including the wild animals;
The birds of heaven and the fish of the sea that travel along the paths of the sea.
Lord, our Lord, how wonderful is your name throughout the earth!
For the end, concerning the hidden things of the son. A psalm of David.
I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will recount all your wonders.
I will rejoice and be glad in you; I will sing psalms to your name, Most High.
When my enemies turn back, they will grow weak and perish before you.
You upheld my cause and my right; you sat on the throne as a righteous judge.
You rebuked the nations, and the wicked one perished; you erased their names forever and ever.
The enemy's weapons failed completely; you devastated the cities, and their memory perished with a clamor.
God stands and remains forever; he prepared his throne for judgment.
He judges the world with righteousness and his peoples with fairness.
The Lord became a refuge for the needy, a helper in distress at the right time.
Let all who know your name trust in you, for you will not abandon those who seek you, Lord.
Sing psalms to the Lord who dwells in Zion; proclaim his deeds among the nations.
When he sought an accounting for their blood, he remembered them, and the Lord did not forget the prayers of the needy.
Have mercy on me, Lord, and see my humiliation at the hands of my enemies, you who lifted me up from the gates of death,
So that I may proclaim all your praises at the gates of the daughter of Zion; I will rejoice in your salvation.
The nations sank into the ruin they made; the snare they hid will catch their feet.
The Lord is known by carrying out his judgments, and sinners will be caught in the works of their own hands.
Let sinners return to the underworld, and all the nations that forgot God.
The Lord does not forget the poor forever; let the endurance of the needy not perish completely.
Arise, Lord, and do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged before you.
Set a lawgiver over them, Lord, and let the nations know that they are human.
Why, Lord, do you stand far away and turn a blind eye in times of distress?
When the ungodly grows arrogant, the poor man burns; let them be caught in the schemes they have devised.
For the sinner is praised for his soul’s desire, and the one who defrauds is also praised.
But why has the sinner provoked God? In his great anger he says, “He will not investigate.” God is not before his eyes.
His ways are defiled at all times; judgments are high above his sight. He will rule over all his enemies.
He said in his heart, “I will not be shaken; from generation to generation I will be without harm.”
His mouth is full of curses, bitterness, and deceit; beneath his tongue are pain and trouble.
He sits in ambush among the powerful to kill the innocent in secret; his eyes watch the needy.
He lies in ambush in secret like a lion in its lair. He lies in ambush to seize the poor, to seize the poor and draw him into his trap.
He will bring him low; he will bow down and fall when he gains power over the needy.
For he said in his heart, “God has forgotten; he has turned his face away so that he will never see.”
Arise, Lord my God; let your hand be lifted high, and do not forget the needy.
But why has the ungodly provoked God? Because he said in his heart, “He will not investigate.”
You see him; you look upon suffering and anger, to take him into your hands. The poor man has entrusted himself to you, and you are the orphan’s helper.
Let the arm of the sinner and the evildoer be broken; let his sins be sought out, and let him not be found.
The Lord is king forever and ever; let the nations perish from his land.
You have heard the desire of the needy, Lord; your ear has attended to the readiness of their hearts.
To give justice to the orphan and the destitute, so that a human being may no longer continue his boasting upon the face of the earth.
For the end. A psalm of David.
I have trusted in the Lord. How can you say to me, “Flee to the mountains like a sparrow”?
For behold, the sinners have drawn their bows and prepared their arrows in their quivers to shoot in the darkness at those who are upright in heart.
For what you built, they destroyed; but what has the righteous man done?
The Lord is in his holy temple; the Lord is in heaven on his throne. His eyes watch the needy; his eyelids examine the children of men.
The Lord examines the righteous and the ungodly; whoever loves sin hates his own soul.
He will rain snares upon sinners; fire and sulfur and a stormy wind will be the portion of their cup.
The Lord is righteous and loves righteousness; his face beholds uprightness.
For the end, for the eighth. A psalm of David.
Save me, Lord, for the godly person is no more, and truthfulness has dwindled among the children of men.
Each man spoke empty words to his neighbor; with deceitful lips he spoke with a double heart.
May the Lord destroy all deceitful lips and boastful tongues.
They said, “We will make our tongues great. Our lips belong to us, and who now is lord over us?”
“Because of the suffering of the poor and the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the Lord. “I will establish my salvation and act boldly among them.”
The words of the Lord are pure words, like silver selected and tested from the earth, purified and refined seven times from the soil.
You, Lord, have kept us and saved us from this generation forever.
The wicked walk all around; according to your exalted greatness, you will make the children of men great.
For the end. A psalm of David.
How long, Lord, will you forget me completely? How long will you turn your face away from me?
How long shall I lay plans within my soul and have sorrow in my heart day after day?
How long will my enemy rise above me?
Look upon me and hear me, Lord my God. Give light to my eyes, Lord, so that I may never sleep in death.
Let my enemy not say, “I have defeated him,” nor let those who oppress me rejoice if I am shaken.
I trusted in your mercy, Lord; my heart rejoiced in your salvation. I will bless the Lord, my benefactor.
For the end. A psalm of David.
The fool said in his heart, “There is no God.” They became corrupt and defiled themselves in their lawlessness, and there is no one who does good.
The Lord looked down from heaven upon all the children of men to see whether there was anyone wise who sought God.
They all turned aside; together they became worthless. There is no one who does good, not even one.
How can all those who practice lawlessness fail to understand—those who ate my people as they would eat bread and did not call upon the Lord?
There they will fear where there is no fear, for the Lord is among the righteous people.
They put the poor person's counsel to shame, because the Lord is his hope.
Who will bring Israel's salvation from Zion? When the Lord brings his people back from captivity, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.
For the end. A psalm of David.
Lord, who will stay in your tent, or who will dwell on your holy mountain?
The one who walks blamelessly, does what is right, and speaks the truth in his heart.
He has not spoken deceitfully with his tongue or done evil to his companion; he does not accept reproaches against his neighbor.
The evildoer is despised in his sight, but he honors those who fear the Lord. He swears to his companion and does not lie.
He does not lend his silver at interest or accept a bribe against the righteous. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.
An inscription of David.
Keep me safe, God, for I have put my hope in you. I said to the Lord, “You are my Lord, and the good things I have come from you.”
For your holy ones who are in your land, you have made all my desires concerning them wonderful.
May their afflictions multiply; after this, let them hurry. I will not gather in their gatherings of blood, nor will I mention their names with my lips.
The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and my cup. You are the one who restores my inheritance to me.
The allotted portions fell to me among choice places, and my inheritance pleased me.
I will bless the Lord, who made me wise; even at night my inner being instructed me.
I always saw the Lord before me, for he is at my right hand so that I will not be shaken.
Therefore my heart was glad and my tongue rejoiced; my body too will dwell in hope.
For you will not abandon my soul to the realm of the dead, nor will you allow your holy one to see decay.
You showed me your paths of life; you filled me with joy in your presence, with the sweetness of the delight at your right hand forever.
A prayer of David.
Hear righteousness, Lord, and attend to my requests. Give ear to my prayers, for they do not come from deceitful lips.
Let judgment in my favor come from your presence, and let my eyes see what is right.
You tested my heart and examined it at night; you tested me, and no injustice was found in me.
Let my mouth not speak of the deeds of the children of humankind. Because of the words of your lips, I will keep to the difficult paths.
Make my steps firm on your path, so that my footsteps do not stumble.
I called to you, Lord, because you heard me, God. Incline your ear to me and hear my words.
You have made your mercies wonderful, you who save those who trust in you from those who oppose your right hand.
Keep me as the pupil of the eye; hide me under the shelter of your wings
from the presence of the ungodly who afflicted me. My enemies surrounded my soul.
They are enclosed in their own fat; their mouths spoke arrogantly.
They drove me away, and now they have surrounded me again. They set their minds on casting me down to the ground.
They seemed to me like a lion ready for the hunt, like a young lion sitting in ambush.

Rise, Lord, confront them and thwart them. Rescue my soul from the ungodly, from the sword and from the enemy’s hand. Lord, destroy them from the earth; divide them and thwart them during their lives.
Their bellies were filled with your hidden treasures; they were satisfied with food and left the remainder to their children.
In righteousness I will appear before your face; I will be satisfied when your glory appears.

For the end. Concerning the fighting champion David, the servant of the Lord, who spoke these words of blessing to the Lord on the day when the Lord delivered him from the hands of all his enemies and from the hands of Saul. And he says:
I will love you, Lord, my strength. The Lord is my support, my refuge, and my deliverer.
God is my helper, and I trust in him. He is my refuge, the horn of my salvation, and my protector.
With praise I will call upon the Lord, and I will be saved from my enemies.
The pangs of death surrounded me, and torrents of lawlessness troubled me.
The sorrows of Hades besieged me, and the snares of death came upon me.
In my distress I called upon the Lord and cried out to my God. From his holy temple he heard the voice of my prayers; let my cry before him enter his ears.
The earth was shaken and trembled, and the foundations of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because God was angry with them.
Smoke rose from his anger, and fire blazed from his face, and flashes of lightning burst forth from him.
He lowered the heavens and came down, and thick darkness was beneath his feet.
He mounted a cherub and flew; he sped upon the wings of the winds.
He made darkness his covering, and his shelters were around him, with dark waters reaching to the clouds of the sky.
At his flashing brightness, the clouds before him sent forth hail and sparks of fire.
The Lord thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave forth his voice amid hail and sparks of fire.
He sent out his arrows and scattered them; he multiplied his flashes of lightning and threw them into confusion.
The springs of water appeared, and the foundations of the world were revealed at your rebuke, Lord, and at the blast of the breath of your anger.
He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of many waters.
The Lord will deliver me from my powerful enemies and from those who hate me, because they were stronger than I.
They came upon me on the day of my afflictions; the Lord became my strength.
And he brought me out into a place of ease, and the Lord will deliver me because he delighted in me.
The Lord will repay me according to my righteousness; according to my blamelessness he will repay me.
I will keep the ways of the Lord and will not act wickedly toward my God.
All his judgments are before me, and he has not taken his righteousness away from me.
I too will be blameless with him and guard myself against my own lawlessness.
The Lord will repay me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands before his eyes.
With the holy you will be holy; with a blameless man you will be blameless.
With the chosen you will be chosen, and you will overthrow the crooked.
You will save the humble people, and you will bring down the eyes of the proud.
You make my lamp shine. Lord my God, give me light in the darkness.
Through you I will be delivered from trials; through my God I will pass over walls.
My God, your ways are blameless, and the words of the Lord are tested. He is a refuge for all who hope in him.
For who is God apart from the Lord? Or who is God apart from our God?
God, you clothed me with strength and made my way blameless.
You made my feet firm like those of a deer and set me on the heights.
You trained my hands for war and made my arm like a strong bow.
You gave me the protection of your salvation. Your right hand supported me, and your discipline raised me up completely; your discipline will teach me.
You made room for my steps beneath me, and my paths did not falter.
I will pursue my enemies and overtake them, and I will not turn back from them until I have destroyed them.
I will press them, and they will no longer be able to stand; they will fall beneath my feet.
You clothed me with strength for battle; you brought beneath me those who rose against me.
You made my enemies flee and destroyed those who hate me.
They cried out, but there was no one to save them. They called to the Lord, but he did not hear them.
I will crush them like dust before the wind; I will trample them like mud in the streets.
The Lord will deliver me from the strife of peoples and set me as the head of nations. A people I did not know served me.
As soon as they heard, they obeyed me; foreigners lied to me.
Foreigners wasted away and limped away from their paths.
The Lord lives, and God is blessed. May the God of my salvation be exalted.
It is God who exacts vengeance for me and subjects peoples to me.
My deliverer from my angry enemies, you raised me above those who rose against me, and you rescued me from an unjust man.
Therefore I will give thanks to you among the nations and sing psalms to your name.
You made great the salvation of his king, showing mercy to his anointed, to David and to his descendants, from generation to generation.
For the end. A psalm of David.
The heavens tell of the glory of God, and the firmament proclaims the works of his hands.
Day pours forth words to day, and night reveals knowledge to night.
There are no words or speech whose sounds are not heard.
Their voice has gone out throughout all the earth, and their words reach the ends of the world.
He set his tent in the sun, and he is like a bridegroom coming out of his bridal chamber. He rejoices like a giant to run his course.
Its rising is from the ends of heaven, and its resting place reaches to heaven’s farthest ends. There is no one who can hide from its heat.
The law of the Lord is spotless and restores souls. The testimony of the Lord is trustworthy and makes children wise.
The ordinances of the Lord are upright and gladden hearts. The commandments of the Lord are light and give light to the eyes.
The fear of the Lord is pure and remains forever. The judgment of the Lord is true and righteous.
It is more desirable than gold and many precious stones; it is sweeter than honeycomb.
For your servant will keep this; in keeping it there is great reward.
Who can perceive his own transgressions? Cleanse me from my hidden faults, Lord.
And protect your servant from strangers. If they do not rule over me, then I will be spotless and free from great sins.
May the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart be pleasing to you, before you at all times, Lord, my helper and my deliverer.
For the end. A psalm of David.
May the Lord hear you on the day of distress; may the name of the God of Jacob be your helper.
May the Lord send you help from his sanctuary and uphold you from Zion.
May the Lord remember all your offerings and make your vows acceptable.
May the Lord grant you what your heart desires, and may he fulfill all your plans.
We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will be made great. May the Lord fulfill all your requests.
Now I know that the Lord saved his anointed. He heard him from heaven, from his sanctuary, through the saving power of his right hand.
Some rely on chariots and others on horses, but we will call on the name of the Lord our God.
They stumbled and fell, but we rose and stood upright.
Lord, save the king, and hear us on the day when we call to you.
For the end. A psalm of David.
Lord, the king will rejoice in your strength; he will rejoice greatly in your salvation.
You gave him his heart’s desire and did not withhold from him the wishes of his lips.
You met him with the blessing of your goodness and placed a crown of precious stone on his head.
He asked you for life, and you gave it to him, with length of days forever and ever.
His glory is great through your salvation; you will place glory and majesty upon him.
You will make him a blessing forever and ever; you will gladden him with the joy of your presence.
The king trusted in the Lord; through the mercy of the Most High he will not be shaken.
Your hand will be upon your enemies, and your right hand will find all who hate you.
You will make them like a fiery furnace when you appear. The Lord will throw them into turmoil in his anger, and fire will devour them.
Their fruit will perish from the earth, and their offspring from among the children of humankind.
They turned against you in wickedness; they devised a plan that they will not be able to carry out.
You will make them fugitives; you will direct their faces toward your survivors.
Be exalted, Lord, in your strength; we will praise and sing psalms to your might.
For the end. Concerning the help of the morning. A psalm of David.
God, my God, look upon me! Why have you forsaken me? You have remained far from my salvation because of the words of my transgressions.
My God, I called to you by day, and you did not hear me; by night, and you did not heed me.
You dwell in the holy places, you who are praised by Israel.
Our fathers trusted in you; they trusted in you, and you delivered them.
They cried out to you and were saved; they trusted in you and were not put to shame.
But I am a worm and not a human being, a reproach among people and an object of contempt among the nations.
All who saw me despised me; they spoke with their lips and shook their heads.
“He trusted in the Lord; let him deliver him! Let him save him, because he delights in him!”
You are the one who brought me out of the womb, my hope from my mother's breasts.
I was cast upon you from the womb; from my mother's womb you are my God.
Do not withdraw from me, for troubles are near, and there is no one to help me.
Many young bulls surrounded me, and fat bulls hemmed me in.
They opened their mouths against me like a lion that roars and tears its prey.
I was poured out like water, and all my bones were scattered. My heart became like wax melting within my belly.
My strength dried up like a potsherd; my tongue stuck to my palate, and they brought me down into the dust of death.
Many dogs surrounded me, and gatherings of evildoers hemmed me in.
They pierced my hands and my feet and counted all my bones. They looked at me and saw me.
They divided my clothes among themselves and cast lots for my robe.
You, Lord, do not keep your help far from me; Lord, attend to helping me.
Rescue my soul from the sword, and my one and only life from the power of dogs.
Rescue me from the lion’s mouth, and my lowly self from the unicorn’s horn.
I will tell my brothers of your name; in the midst of the assembly I will praise you.
You who fear the Lord, praise the Lord. Let all the descendants of Jacob glorify him, and let all the descendants of Israel fear the Lord.
For the Lord did not despise or scorn the prayers of this poor man, nor did he turn his face away from me. Instead, when I called to him, he heard me.
My praise comes from you in the great assemblies. I will praise you; I will fulfill my vows before all who fear him.
The poor will eat and be satisfied. Those who seek the Lord will praise him. Their hearts will live forever and ever.
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord; all the families of the nations will bow down to him.
For the kingdom belongs to the Lord, and he rules over all the nations.
All the prosperous people of the earth ate and bowed down to him. All who descend into the dust will fall before him.
My soul lives through him, and my descendants will serve him.
The coming generation will be told about the Lord. They will proclaim his righteousness to a people yet to be born, whom the Lord has made.
For the end. A psalm of David.
The Lord will shepherd me, and I will lack nothing. He settled me there in a green pasture and nourished me beside restful waters.
He restored my soul to me. He led me along paths of righteousness for the sake of his name.
Even if I walk amid the shadows of death, I will fear no evil, for you, Lord, are with me. Your rod and your staff will comfort me.
You prepared a table before me in the sight of those who oppress me. You anointed my head with oil; your cup, like unmixed wine, made me drunk.
Your mercy, Lord, will follow me all the days of my life, so that I may dwell in the house of the Lord for many days.
A psalm of David, for the first day of the week.
The earth and all that fills it belong to the Lord, the world and all its inhabitants.
He himself laid its foundations upon the sea and established it upon the rivers.
Who will ascend the mountain of the Lord, or who will stand in his holy place?
The one whose hands are clean and whose heart is blameless, who has not given himself over to vanity and has not sworn deceitfully to his neighbor.
He will receive a blessing from the Lord and mercy from God his Savior.
This is the generation that seeks the Lord, that seeks to see the face of the God of Jacob.
Lift up your gates, you rulers; let the everlasting gates be lifted up, and the King of glory will enter.
Who is this King of glory? The Lord, mighty in his strength, the Lord, mighty in battle.
Lift up your gates, you rulers; let the everlasting gates be lifted up, and the King of glory will enter.
Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts: he himself is the King of glory.
For the end. A psalm of David.
To you, Lord, I lift up my soul.
My God, I have trusted in you. Do not let me be put to shame, and do not let my enemies laugh at me.
Let none who wait for you be put to shame; instead, let the lawless be put to shame in their futility.
Show me your ways, Lord, and teach me your paths. Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and I wait for you all day long.
Remember, Lord, your compassion and your mercies, which are from eternity.
Do not remember the sins of my youth or of my ignorance. Instead, remember me, Lord, according to your mercy, because of your goodness.
For you are good and upright, Lord; therefore you instruct sinners in the way.
You guide the meek in justice and teach the meek your ways.
All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth for those who seek his covenant and his testimonies.
For your name's sake, Lord, forgive my sins, for they are many.
Who is the person who fears the Lord? He will instruct him in the way he has chosen.
His soul will rest in goodness, and his descendants will inherit the earth.
The Lord is the strength of those who fear him, and he teaches them his covenants.
My eyes are always turned toward the Lord, and he brings my feet out of the snare.
Look toward me and have mercy on me, for I am alone and poor.
The troubles of my heart have become very many; bring me out of my afflictions.
See my lowliness and my toil, and forgive all my sins.
See my enemies, for they have become many, and the groundless hatred with which they hate me.
Guard my soul and rescue me. Do not let me be put to shame, for I have trusted in you.
The blameless and upright have joined me, and I wait for you.
Save Israel, O God, from all his troubles.
For the end. A psalm of David.
Judge me, Lord, for I have walked in my innocence. I have put my hope in the Lord, so that I may not grow weak.
Test me, Lord, and examine me; test my kidneys and my heart.
Your mercy, Lord, is before my eyes, and I will be pleasing in your truth.
I will not sit in the seats of vain people, and I will not enter with the lawless.
I have hated the gatherings of evildoers, and I will not sit with the ungodly.
I will wash my hands in purity and go around your altar, Lord,
so that I may hear the sound of your blessing and recount all your wonders.
Lord, I have loved the beauty of your house and the dwelling place of your glory.
Do not destroy my soul with the ungodly, or my life with bloodthirsty men,
whose hands are engaged in lawlessness and whose right hand is full of bribes.
I have walked in my innocence. Save me, Lord, and have mercy on me.
My foot will stand on level ground; in the great assemblies I will bless you.
A psalm of David, before he was anointed.
The Lord is my light and my life; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the refuge of my life; before whom shall I tremble?
When evildoers approached me to devour my flesh, my oppressors and my enemies grew weak and fell.
If war is prepared against me, my heart will not fear. If battle rises against me, even in this I have put my hope in you, Lord.
One thing I have asked of the Lord, and this I plead for: that I may dwell in the Lord’s house all the days of my life, that I may see the Lord’s beauty and give commands in his temple.
He hid me in his tabernacle on the day of trouble; he sheltered me in the hiding place of his tabernacle. You raised me high upon a rock.
And now lift my head above my enemies. I will go around and offer a sacrifice of praise in his tabernacle; I will praise and sing psalms to the Lord.
Hear my voice, Lord, for I have cried out to you. Have mercy on me and hear me.
For my heart spoke to you, and my face sought you. I will seek your face, Lord.
Do not turn your face away from me, and do not turn away in anger from your servant. Be my helper, Lord; do not reject me or abandon me, O God my Savior.
My father and my mother abandoned me, but the Lord received me.
Instruct me, Lord, in your way, and lead me along your straight paths.
Because of my enemies, do not hand me over to my oppressors. Witnesses accusing me of sins rose against me and lied against me in their lawlessness.
I believed that I would see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.
Wait for the Lord and take courage. Let your heart grow strong, and wait for the Lord.
A psalm of David.
To you, Lord, I cried. My God, do not be silent toward me. Never be silent toward me, lest I become like those who go down into the pit.
Hear, Lord, the voice of my petitions as I plead with you, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
Do not count me among the ungodly, and do not destroy me with those who practice lawlessness, who spoke peace with their neighbors while evil was in their hearts.
Give them, Lord, according to their deeds and according to the lawlessness of their ways. Repay them according to the works of their hands; give them their own recompense.
They did not understand the works of the Lord, nor did they consider the works of his hands. You will tear them down, and they will not be built up again.
Blessed is the Lord, for he heard the voice of my prayers.
The Lord is my helper and my protector. My heart trusted in him and was helped, and my body rejoiced. I will willingly give him praise.
The Lord is the strength of his people, the refuge of salvation for his anointed one.
Save your people and bless your inheritance. Shepherd them and lift them up forever.
A psalm of David.
Bring offerings to the Lord, sons of God. Bring young rams to the Lord. Give the Lord glory and honor.
Give the Lord the glory of his name, and worship the Lord in his holy court.
The voice of the Lord is over the waters, and the God of glory thundered. The Lord himself is over the mighty waters.
The voice of the Lord is powerful, and the voice of the Lord is full of great majesty.
The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars, and the Lord shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
He will crush them like the young sapling of Lebanon, which is beloved like the offspring of a unicorn.
The voice of the Lord divides the flame of fire.
The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness, and the Lord throws the wilderness of Kadesh into turmoil.
The voice of the Lord strengthens the deer and lays bare the forests. In his temple everyone will proclaim his glory.
The Lord makes the floods settle and subside. The Lord will reign forever.
The Lord will give strength to his people and will bless his people with peace.
A psalm of praise for the dedication of the temple. Of David.
I exalt you, Lord, for you received me and did not let my enemy rejoice over me.
Lord my God, I cried to you, and you healed me.
Lord, you brought my soul up from the realm of the dead.
You saved me from among those who go down into the pit.
Sing psalms to the Lord, you his holy ones; give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
There is wrath in his anger, and life in his favor. Weeping may lodge for the evening, but joy will come in the morning.
In my prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”
Lord, by your favor you gave strength to my beauty. You turned your face away from me, and I became troubled.
To you, Lord, I called, and to my God I cried out.
What benefit is my blood to you if I go down to decay? Will the dust give thanks to you, or proclaim your truth?
The Lord heard me and had mercy on me, and the Lord became my helper.
He turned my mourning into joy, removed my sackcloth from me, and clothed me with gladness.
So that my glory may sing psalms to you, and I may grieve no more. Lord my God, I will give thanks to you forever.
For the end. A hymn of triumph. A psalm of David.
In you, Lord, I have put my hope; let me never be put to shame. In your righteousness deliver me and save me.
Incline your ear to me; hurry to save me. Be my protecting God and a house of refuge to save me.
For you are my strength and my refuge. For your name’s sake you guided me and nourished me.
You will bring me out of this snare that was hidden for me. You are my protector, Lord.
Into your hands I entrust my spirit. You have redeemed me, Lord God, by your truth.
You hated those who revere worthless things, but I have put my hope in the Lord.
I will rejoice and be glad in your salvation. You looked upon my lowliness and delivered my soul from afflictions.
You did not hand me over to my oppressors, and you set my feet in a spacious place.
Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am afflicted. My eye is troubled by anger, as are my soul and my belly.
My life is wasting away with pain, and my years with sighing. My strength has dwindled through weakness, and my bones are troubled.
More than all my enemies, I became a reproach to my neighbors, a great terror and dread to my acquaintances. Everyone who saw me outside fled from me.
I was forgotten, like a dead person gone from the heart, and I became like a lost vessel.
For I heard the slander of many who were around me. When they gathered together, they plotted to take my life.
But I put my hope in you, Lord. I said, “You are my God.”
My inheritance is in your hands. Deliver me from the hands of my enemies and from my persecutors.
Let your face shine upon your servant. Save me, Lord, according to your mercy.
Lord, do not let me be put to shame, for I have called to you. Let the wicked be put to shame and go down to the underworld.
Let deceitful lips be silenced, which spoke unjustly against the righteous in their arrogance and contempt.
How abundant is the mercy of your goodness, Lord, which you have stored up for those who fear you! You have shown it to those who trust in you before the children of humankind.
You have secured them in the shelter of your presence against the turmoil of people. You have hidden them in your tent from the strife of tongues.
Blessed is the Lord, for he has shown me his wonderful mercy in a fortified city.
In my astonishment I said, “I have been cast away from before your eyes.” Therefore you heard the sound of my prayers when I cried out to you.
Love the Lord, all his holy ones, for the Lord seeks truth and repays those who act with excessive arrogance.
Take courage, and let your hearts grow strong, all you who trust in the Lord.
A psalm of wisdom. Of David.
Blessed is the one whose sins have been forgiven and whose transgressions have all been covered.
Blessed is the man whose sins the Lord will not count against him, and in whose mouth there is no deceit.
I remained silent, and all my bones wasted away as I cried out to the Lord all day long.
Day and night your hand lay heavy upon me. I fell into misery, because thorns pierced me. Rest.
I will reveal my sins to you, and I will not hide my lawlessness from you. I said, “I will confess my sins against myself, and you will forgive all the wickedness of my sins.” Rest.
For this reason all the holy ones will pray to you at an acceptable time. Only, the flood of many waters will not come near them.
You are my refuge from this distress that has surrounded me. My joy, deliver me from those who have besieged me.
I will make you wise and give you understanding of the way you are to go, and I will keep my eyes fixed on you.
Do not be like horses and mules, for they have no understanding. Clamp with bridle and bit the jaws of those that will not come near you.
Many are the torments of sinners, but the Lord’s mercy will surround those who trust in the Lord.
Be glad and rejoice in the Lord, you righteous ones. Glory in him, all you who are upright in heart.
A psalm of David.
Rejoice in the Lord, you righteous ones. Praise is fitting for the upright.
Give thanks to the Lord with praise; sing psalms to him with a ten-stringed instrument.
Praise the Lord with a new song of praise, for he is good. Sing psalms to him with praise.
The Lord’s words are upright, and all his works are faithful.
The Lord loves mercy and justice. The earth is filled with the Lord’s mercy.
And by the word of the Lord the heavens were established, and by the breath of his mouth all their hosts.
He gathered the waters of the sea as into a waterskin, and he places his treasures in the depths.
Let all the earth fear the Lord, and let all the inhabitants of the world tremble before him.
For he spoke, and they came into being; he commanded, and they were established.
The Lord scatters the plans of the nations; the Lord rejects the plans of the peoples, and the Lord scorns the plans of rulers.
The counsel of the Lord remains forever, the thoughts of his heart from generation to generation.
Blessed is the nation whose helper is the Lord God, the people whom he chose as his inheritance.
The Lord looked down from heaven upon all the children of humankind.
From his established dwelling he looked upon all the inhabitants of the world.
He who formed their hearts individually considers all their deeds.
A king will not be saved by his great army, nor a giant by his great strength.
A horse is a false hope for salvation; despite its great strength, it cannot save its rider.
The eyes of the Lord are upon those who fear him and those who hope in his mercy.
To deliver their lives from death and feed them in famine.
Our souls will wait for the Lord, for he is our helper and protector.
Our hearts will rejoice in him, and we will trust in his holy name.
Let your mercy be upon us, Lord, just as we have hoped in you.
A psalm of David, when he changed his appearance before Abimelech, who then dismissed him, and he went away.
I will bless the Lord at all times; his praise will be in my mouth at all times.
My soul will boast in the Lord; let the humble hear and rejoice.
Magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.
I sought the Lord, and he heard me; he delivered me from all my distress.
Draw near to the Lord and receive light, and let your faces not be put to shame.
This poor man cried out to the Lord, and the Lord heard him; he delivered him from all his distress.
The camp of the Lord’s angels surrounds those who fear him and guards them.
Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the man who trusts in him.
Fear the Lord, all his holy ones, for those who fear him lack nothing.
The mighty became poor and hungry, but let those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.
Come, my children, and listen to me, and I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
Who is the person who desires life and loves his days, wishing to see good things?
Keep your tongue from evil, and let your lips speak no deceit.
Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears attend to their prayers.
The face of the Lord is against evildoers, to wipe out their memory from the earth.
The righteous cried out to the Lord, and the Lord heard them and rescued them from all their distress.
The Lord is near to those whose hearts are crushed, and he saves those who are humble in spirit.
The afflictions of the righteous are many; the Lord rescues them from them all.
And he guards all their bones; let not one of them be broken.
The death of a sinner is evil, but whoever hates the righteous will regret it.
The Lord redeems the souls of his servants; let none who have put their hope in him regret it.
For the end. A psalm of David.
Judge, Lord, those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.
Take up your weapon and your shield, and rise to help me.
Draw your sword against my pursuers; stop them, and say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”
Let those who sought my life be ashamed and put to shame; let those who plotted evil against me turn back and be ashamed.
Let them be like dust before the wind, and let the angel of the Lord harass them.
Let their paths be dark and treacherous, and let the angel of God pursue them.
Without cause they hid a snare for me in their destruction, and without cause they insulted my soul.
Let a snare they did not know about come upon them, and let the trap they hid catch their feet, and let them fall into that same snare.
But my soul will rejoice in the Lord and be glad in his salvation.
And all my bones will say, “Lord, who is like you? For you rescued the poor from the hands of the powerful, the poor and needy from those who plunder them.”
Malicious witnesses rose up against me; they questioned me about things I did not know.
They repaid me evil for good; they plotted to leave me with no inheritance among the children of mankind.
When they were afflicted, I put on sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting. May my prayers return to my own breast.
I sought to please them as a brother and a friend; I humbled myself as one mourning and grieving.
They rejoiced over me and gathered together; scourges gathered against me, and I did not know it. They scattered and did not repent.
They tested me and treated me with contempt; in contempt they gnashed their teeth at me.
Lord, when will you look? Rescue my life from their cunning, and my one and only life from the lions.
I will give thanks to you, Lord, in great assemblies, and I will praise you among gathered multitudes.
Do not let my enemies rejoice over me, those who hated me without cause and winked at me with their eyes.
They spoke peace to me, while they themselves angrily plotted deceit.
They opened their mouths against me and said, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen it!”
You have seen it, Lord; do not be silent. Lord, do not stay far from me.
Awake, Lord, and attend to my cause; my God and my Lord, attend to my judgment.
Judge me according to your righteousness, Lord my God; do not let my enemies rejoice over me.
And do not let them say in their hearts, “Hurrah, hurrah for us, for we have swallowed him up!”
Let those who rejoiced at my misfortune be ashamed and put to shame. Let those who boasted against me be clothed with shame and dishonor.
Let all who desire my righteousness rejoice and be glad in you. Let them always say, “God is great,” along with those who desire the peace of your servant.
My tongue will speak of your righteousness and of your praise all day long.
For the end. A psalm of David, the servant of the Lord.
The lawless man says in his own mind as he sins that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
He practiced deceit in his sight, to find lawlessness and hate it.
The words of his mouth are lawlessness and deceit; he did not wish to understand what is good.
He plotted lawlessness on his bed; he stood on every path that is not good, and he did not grow weary of evil.
Lord, your mercy is in the heavens, and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Your righteousness is like mountains, O God; your judgments are like great depths. You preserve humans and animals, Lord.
How greatly you have increased your mercy, God! But the children of mankind will place their hope in the shelter of your wings.
They will drink their fill of the richness of your house, and you will give them the torrents of your delight to drink.
From you, Lord, comes the fountain of life, and by the light of your face we see light.
Shine your mercy upon those who know you, and your righteousness upon those who are upright in heart.
Let the foot of the proud not come upon us, and let the hands of sinners not shake us.
There all who practice lawlessness will fall. They will be cast out and will no longer be able to stand.
A Psalm of David.
Do not envy the wicked, nor those who practice lawlessness.
For they will quickly dry up like grass; like green grass they will quickly pass away.
Trust in the Lord and do good. Dwell in the land, and you will be nourished by its abundance.
Delight in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Make your ways known before the Lord and trust in him; he will act.
And he will bring forth your righteousness like light, and your justice like midday.
Submit to the Lord and serve him. Do not envy those whose ways prosper, nor the person who practices lawlessness.
Refrain from anger and cease from wrath, and do not envy the wicked.
For the wicked will quickly be destroyed, but those who wait patiently for the Lord will inherit the earth.
In a little while the ungodly will be no more; you will look for his place and will not find it.
But the meek will inherit the earth and delight in their abundant peace.
The sinner lies in wait for the righteous and gnashes his teeth at him.
But the Lord will laugh at him, for he sees beforehand that his day has come.
Sinners drew their swords and bent their bows to strike the poor and needy and to kill the one who is humble in heart.
Their swords will enter their own hearts, and their bows will be shattered.
The little that a righteous person has is better than the great wealth of sinners.
And the arms of the ungodly will be broken, but the Lord upholds the righteous.
And he knows the days of the blameless; their inheritance will last forever.
Let them not be put to shame in times of trouble; in days of famine they will be satisfied.
Behold, sinners will perish, and the Lord’s enemies, as they are glorified and exalted, will vanish like smoke that fades away.
The sinner borrows and does not repay, but the righteous person shows mercy and gives.
Those who bless the Lord will inherit the earth, and those who curse will be destroyed by him.
A person’s steps are directed by the Lord, and he greatly delights in that person’s ways.
Even if he stumbles, let him not fall down, for the Lord holds his hand.
I was young and have grown old, and I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his offspring begging for bread.
He continually shows mercy and lends; his offspring will be blessed forever.
Turn away from evil and do good, and you will dwell in it forever and ever.
The Lord loves justice and does not cast down his holy ones, but preserves them forever. The lawless will be driven away together, and the offspring of the ungodly will be destroyed.
But the righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever and ever.
The mouth of the righteous declares wisdom, and his tongue will speak justice.
The law of his God is in his heart; let his steps not stumble.
The sinner watches the righteous and seeks to kill him.
But the Lord does not leave him in his hands and does not condemn him when he judges him.
Wait for the Lord and keep his ways, and he will raise you up to inherit the land, and you will see the destruction of sinners.
I saw the wicked man exalted and towering like the cedars of Lebanon.
I passed by, and he was gone. I searched, but his place was not found.
Preserve blamelessness and look to uprightness, for the peacemaker has descendants.
The lawless will be driven away together, and the offspring of the ungodly will perish.
The salvation of the righteous comes from the Lord. He watches over them in times of distress.
The Lord will help them and deliver them; he will rescue them from sinners and save them, because they trusted in him.
A psalm of David, for remembrance of the Sabbath.
Lord, do not rebuke me in your indignation or discipline me in your anger.
For your arrows struck me, and your hand rested heavily upon me.
There is no healing in my body because of your anger, and there is no peace in my bones because of my sins.
My lawless deeds rose above my head; like a heavy burden, they weighed upon me.
My wounds became foul and rotted because of my foolishness.
I suffered and was brought very low; I went about mourning continually.
For my soul was filled with torments, and there is no healing in my body.
I suffered and was brought very low; I roared because of the groaning of my heart.
Lord, all my desire is before you, and my groaning was not hidden from you.
My heart was troubled within me, and my strength left me; even the light of my eyes was no longer with me.
My friends and companions came near and stood before me, and my relatives stood far away from me.
They oppressed me and sought my life. Those who sought to harm me spoke lawlessness and continually plotted deceit.
But I am like a deaf man who does not hear, like a mute man who does not open his mouth.
I became like a man who does not hear and has no words in his mouth.
I have put my hope in you, Lord, and you will hear me, Lord my God.
I said, “Do not let my enemies rejoice over me.” When my feet faltered, they spoke boastfully against me.
I am ready for suffering, and my pain is before me at all times.
I will declare my lawlessness and be troubled over my sins.
But now my enemies are alive and stronger than I am, and many hated me without cause.
Those who repaid me evil for good slandered me because I pursued righteousness.
Do not forsake me, Lord my God, and do not withdraw from me. Turn to help me, Lord of my salvation.
For the end. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
I said, “I will guard my ways so that I do not sin with my tongue.” I set a guard over my mouth while the sinner opposed me.
I became deaf and humbled myself; I kept silent even about good things, and my pain was renewed within me.
My heart grew hot in my belly, and a fire blazed in my thoughts.
I spoke with my tongue and said, “Show me, Lord, my end and the number of my days, how many they are, so that I may know how much I fall short.”
You have set my days within a measure, and the extent of my strength is like nothing before me. Indeed, every mortal is altogether vain.
Surely a person walks about like an image, yet is troubled in vain. He stores up treasure and does not know for whom he gathers it.
And now, who is my hope if not you, Lord? And from whom comes the capacity of my strength, if not from you?
You rescued me from all my lawlessness and made me an object of reproach to fools.
I kept silent and did not open my mouth, because you did it.
Remove my afflictions from me, for I have wasted away under the power of your hand.
With rebuke you disciplined a person for sins; you wore away his life like a spider’s web. Indeed, every person is vain. Pause.
Hear my prayers, Lord; give ear to my requests. Do not be silent at my tears. I am a sojourner before you, a stranger and a passing traveler, like all my fathers.
Leave me alone so that I may rest, before I depart to where I will no longer be found.
For the end. A psalm of David.
I waited patiently for the Lord, and he turned toward me and heard my prayers.
He brought me up from the pit of suffering, from clay and mud. He set my feet firmly upon a rock and made my steps straight.
He put a new song of praise in my mouth, a song of praise to the Lord our God.
Many will see and fear and put their hope in the Lord. Blessed is the man whose hope is the name of the Lord, who has not turned toward vanity or deceitful folly.
You have done many wonders, O Lord my God, and in your plans no one is like you. I recounted them and spoke of them, and they were more than could be counted.
You did not delight in sacrifices and offerings; you prepared ears for me. You did not ask for burnt offerings or offerings for sin.
Then I said, “Look, I have come. In the scroll of the book it is written about me.
I desired to do your will, my God, and your law is deep within me.”
I will proclaim the good news of your righteousness in the great assembly. Look, I will not withhold my lips from you; Lord, you know.
For I did not hide your righteousness in my heart. I spoke of your truth and your salvation, and I did not conceal your mercy and your truth from the great congregation.
But you, Lord, do not keep your compassion far from me. May your mercy and your truth sustain me at all times.
Evils beyond number surrounded me. My lawless deeds overtook me, and I could not see. They became more numerous than the hairs of my head, and my heart failed me.
Be pleased, Lord, to deliver me; Lord, look to help me.
Let those who sought my life to take it away be ashamed and put to shame. Let those who sought evil for me turn back and be ashamed.
Let those who said to me, “Aha, aha!” immediately and swiftly bear shame.
Let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you, Lord, and let those who love your salvation always say, “God is great!”
I am poor and needy. God, take thought for me. You are my helper and protector; my God, do not delay.
For the end. A psalm of David.
Blessed is the one who considers the poor and needy; the Lord delivers him on the day of trouble.
The Lord rescues him and keeps him alive, makes him blessed on the earth, and does not deliver him into the hands of his enemies.
The Lord is his helper on his bed of pain; he turns his entire bed away from his illness.
I said, “Lord, have mercy on me. Heal my soul, for I have sinned against you.”
My enemies spoke evil against me: “When will he die and his name perish?”
He would come to see me, speak empty words in his heart, and gather lawlessness to himself. He would go outside and speak the same things.
All my enemies whispered about me; they plotted evil against me.
They laid a lawless word against me: “Will the one who lies down not rise again?”
For even the man who was at peace with me, in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, repeatedly acted deceitfully toward me.
But you, Lord, have mercy on me. Raise me up, and I will repay them.
By this I will know that you are pleased with me: that my enemies do not rejoice over me.
But you upheld me in my innocence and established me before you forever.
Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, forever and ever. So be it, so be it.
For the end. An instruction of the sons of Korah.
As a deer longs for springs of water, so my soul longs for you, O God.
My soul thirsts for you, the mighty and living God. When shall I come and appear before the face of God?
My tears became my food by day and by night, because they kept saying to me every day, “Where is your God?”

As I remembered these things, my soul suffered within me. I encouraged myself to enter beneath the wonderful roof of the house of God, with the sound of rejoicing and thanksgiving, and with the sound of celebration.
Why, then, are you sad, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope in God; give thanks to him. God is the savior of my countenance.
My soul was greatly troubled; therefore I remembered you from the land of the Jordan, from Hermon, from the little mountain.
Deep called to deep, to you, at the sound of your waterfalls. All your surges and your waves passed over me.
By day the Lord commanded his mercy; at night, a new blessing and my prayer to God for my life.
I said to God, “You are my support. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go about in sorrow when my enemy oppresses me?”
As my bones were being crushed, my enemies taunted me, saying to me every day, “Where is your God?”
Why, then, are you sad, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope in God; give thanks to him. God is the savior of my countenance.
A psalm of David.
Judge me, O God, and vindicate me in my case against a nation that is not holy; rescue me from a sinful, deceitful man.
You, O God, are my strength. Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go about in sorrow when my enemy oppresses me?
Send out your light and your truth, O Lord, so that they may guide me and bring me to the holy mountain and to your dwelling places.
I will come before the altar of God, to God who makes my youth glad. I will give thanks to you with praise, O God, my God.
Why, then, are you sad, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope in God; give thanks to him. God is the savior of my countenance.
For the end. Instruction of the sons of Korah. A psalm of David.
O God, we have heard with our own ears what our fathers told us: the work you did in their days, in the days of old.
Your hand uprooted the nations, and you planted them. You afflicted the peoples and drove them out.
For they did not inherit the land by their own sword, nor did their own arm save them, but your right hand and your arm and the light of your face, because you were pleased with them.
You yourself are my King and my God, who commanded deliverance for Jacob.
Through you we will strike down our enemies, and in your name we will scorn those who rise against us.
For I have not put my trust in my bow, nor will my sword save me.
But you saved us from our enemies and put those who hate us to shame.
In God we will boast every day, and we will give thanks to his name forever.
But now you have rejected and dishonored us, and you have not gone out with our armies, O God.
You have made us retreat before our enemies, and those who hate us have plundered us.
You have given us up like sheep for slaughter and scattered us among the nations.
You have sold your people without a price, and there is no counting our cries.
You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, an object of mockery and derision to the jesters around us.
You have made us a byword among the nations, a cause for the peoples to shake their heads.
All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face.
At the voice of the one who reproaches and slanders, before the enemy and persecutor.
All this came upon us, yet we did not forget you or prove false to your covenant.
Nor did we turn back in our hearts; you turned our paths away from your ways.
You brought us low in a place of suffering, and the shadows of death covered us.
If we have forgotten the name of our God or stretched out our hands to foreign gods,
yet God searches this out, for he examines the secrets of our hearts.
For your sake we are put to death all day long; we were counted as sheep for slaughter.
Awake! Why do you sleep, Lord? Rise up, and do not reject us utterly.
Why do you turn your face away from us and forget our poverty and our afflictions?
Our souls were brought low to the dust, and our backs clung to the earth.
Rise up, Lord, help us, and deliver us for the sake of your name.
For the end, concerning the [?] times. For the sons of Korah. An instructive psalm of praise concerning the beloved.
Let my heart pour forth your good sayings, and I speak of my works to the king. My tongue is like the pen of a swift-writing scribe.
You are more beautiful in appearance than all the sons of men. Grace has been poured upon your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
Gird your sword at your waist, Mighty One, in your splendor and beauty.
Draw your bow, aim straight, and reign for the sake of truth, gentleness, and righteousness; and your right hand will guide you wonderfully.
Your arrows are sharp, Mighty One, and peoples will fall beneath you—in the hearts of the king’s enemies.
Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; the scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of uprightness.
You loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, your God, anointed you with the oil of gladness above your companions.
Myrrh, stacte, and cassia come from your garment, from ivory palaces, from which they made you glad.
Daughters of kings are held in honor. The queen shall stand at your right hand, adorned and splendidly dressed in garments woven with gold.
Listen, daughter, and see; incline your ear. Forget your people and your father’s house.
For the king desired your beauty. He himself is your Lord; bow down to him.
And the daughter of Tyre shall bow down to him, and the great among the peoples shall seek his favor with offerings.
All the glory of the king’s daughter is within.
Adorned and splendidly dressed in fringes woven with gold, virgins shall be brought to the king after her, and her companions shall be brought to him.
They shall be led with rejoicing and gladness and brought into the king’s temple.
And in place of your fathers shall be your sons; you shall appoint them rulers over all the earth.
Your name shall be remembered through all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you praise forever and forever and ever.
For the end. Of the sons of Korah. Concerning hidden things.
God is our refuge and strength, a helper in the troubles that have greatly beset us.
Therefore we shall not fear when the earth is shaken, when the mountains are moved into the heart of the sea.
Their waters roared and were troubled; the mountains were shaken by his power.
The streams of rivers gladden the city of God, and the Most High made his dwellings holy.
God is in their midst, and they shall not be shaken. God shall help them from morning until morning.
The nations were troubled, and kingdoms were brought low. The Most High gave forth his voice, and the earth was shaken.
The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge.
Come and see the works of God, who made signs and works of skill upon the earth.
He struck down war from one end of the earth to the other. He shattered bows, broke weapons, and burned shields with fire.
Make haste and know that I am God. I shall be exalted among the nations and lifted high over the earth.
The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge.
For the end. For the sons of Korah. A psalm of David.
Clap your hands, all nations; cry out to God with a voice of rejoicing.
The Lord is exalted and fearsome, a great king over all the earth.
He subjected peoples to us and nations beneath our feet.
He chose us for himself as an inheritance, the splendors of Jacob, whom he loved.
God ascended with praise, and our Lord with the sound of a trumpet.
Sing psalms to our God; sing psalms to our King; sing psalms.
God is a great king over all the earth; sing psalms to him with understanding.
God has reigned over the nations; God has sat upon his holy throne.
The rulers of the peoples gathered before the God of Abraham, for the powers of God have been greatly exalted from the earth.
A psalm of praise by the sons of Korah, for the second day of the week.
Great is the Lord and greatly praised in the city of our God, on his holy mountain.
Firmly rooted, let all the earth rejoice with joy—the mountains of Zion, the northern slopes, the city of the great King.
God is known in his temple at the time when he became their helper.
Behold, the kingdoms of the earth gathered and passed by together.
They themselves saw this and were amazed; they were troubled and shaken.
Trembling seized them there, pains like those of childbirth.
With a fierce wind you will shatter the ships of Tarshish.
As we heard, so we have also seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God. God laid its foundations forever.
We have received your mercy, O God, in the midst of your people.
As is your name, O God, so is your praise throughout the whole world, and your right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion rejoice, and let the daughters of Judah exult because of your judgments, O Lord.
Go around Zion and surround it; encircle its towers.
Set your hearts upon its defenses; distinguish its strongholds, so that you may tell another generation.
This is God, our God forever and ever, and he will shepherd us forever.
For the end. A psalm by the sons of Korah.
Hear this, all nations; listen, all who dwell in the world.
Those born of the earth and the sons of men, the great and the poor together.
My mouth will speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will speak understanding.
I will incline my ear to a parable; I will disclose the parables of praise from the beginning.
Why should I be afraid at all on an evil day, when the sins of my steps have surrounded me?
Those who trust in their own power will boast in the abundance of their wealth.
A brother cannot redeem, nor can a man redeem, nor can he give God a ransom,
nor the price of redemption for his own soul.
Labor forever, and you will live to the end and will not see corruption.
When you see that the wise die, the foolish and the senseless will perish together and leave their wealth to strangers.
Their graves will be their homes forever, and their dwellings from generation to generation, and their names will be proclaimed in their own lands.
Man was held in honor but did not understand; he became equal to the beasts without reason and became like them.
This is their path of stumbling; afterward these same people will express approval with their mouths.

Like sheep they will be handed over to Hades, and death will shepherd them. The upright will rule over them in the morning. Their sources of help will waste away in Hades, and they will fall from their glory.
Yet God will rescue my soul from the hands of Hades when they receive me.
Do not be afraid when a man becomes great and when the glory of his house increases.
For when he dies, he will not take everything with him, nor will the glory of his house descend with him.
But his soul will be blessed during his lifetime; he will give thanks to you when you do him good.
He will enter among the generations of his fathers; he will never see light.
Man was held in honor but did not understand; he became equal to the beasts without reason and became like them.
A psalm of Asaph.
God, the God of gods, the Lord, spoke and called the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting.
From Zion comes the great splendor of the salvation of his beauty.
Our God will come openly, and our God will not remain silent. Fire will blaze before him, and a mighty storm will surround him.
He will call heaven from above and the earth, to judge his people,
to gather his holy ones to himself, and those who place covenant sacrifices upon his altar.
The heavens will proclaim his righteousness, for God is judge. Pause.
Listen, my people, and I will speak to you; Israel, I will testify to you, for I am God, your God.
I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, for your burnt offerings are before me at all times.
I will not accept bulls from your house or male goats from your flocks.
Every beast of the forest is mine, the wild animals of the mountains and all livestock.
I know every bird of heaven, and the beauty of the countryside is with me.
If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world and everything in it are mine.
I do not eat the flesh of your bulls or drink the blood of your male goats.
Offer God a sacrifice of praise, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
Call upon me on the day of your distress; I will rescue you, and you will glorify me.
But God says to the sinner: Why do you recount my righteousness at all, or take my covenant into your mouth?
For you hated my instruction; you rejected and cast behind you all the words of my mouth.
When you saw thieves, you went along with them, and you cast your lot with adulterers.
Your mouth abounded in wickedness, and your tongue devised deceit.
You sat and spoke evil of your brother, and you placed a stumbling block before your mother's son.
You did all these things, and I remained silent toward you. You lawless one, you thought in your mind that I would be like you. Now I will rebuke you and set all these things before you.
Understand this, all you who have forgotten God, lest you be snatched away and there be no one to rescue you.
A sacrifice of praise will glorify me, and there is the way by which I will show him the salvation of God.
For the end. A psalm of David.
When Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.
Have mercy on me, God, according to your great mercy; according to your abundant compassion, blot out my lawlessness.
Wash me thoroughly from my lawlessness, and cleanse me from my sins.
I myself know my lawless deeds, and my sins are before me at all times.
Against you alone I have sinned, O Lord, and have done evil before you, so that you may be justified in your words and victorious when you are judged.
My mother conceived in lawlessness and gave birth to me in sins.
You, Lord, loved truth; through your wisdom you revealed to me the unknown and hidden things.
Sprinkle me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Let me hear gladness and joy, and let my afflicted bones rejoice.
Turn your face away from my sins, and remove all my lawless deeds from me.
Create a pure heart in me, God, and renew an upright spirit within me.
Do not cast me away from your presence, Lord, and do not take your Holy Spirit from me.
Give me the joy of your salvation, and uphold me with your ruling spirit.
I will teach the lawless your ways, and the ungodly will turn to you.
Deliver me from bloodshed, God, God of my salvation, and my tongue will rejoice in your righteousness.
Lord, if you open my lips, my mouth will sing your praises.
If you had desired sacrifices, we would have offered them, but you took no pleasure even in burnt offerings.
The sacrifice to God is a humble spirit; God does not despise a pure heart and a humble spirit.
Do good to Zion, Lord, according to your will, and let the walls of Jerusalem be built.
Then you will take pleasure in sacrifices of righteousness, sacrifices of vows; they will bring calves to your altar.
For the end. A psalm of David.
When Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “Look, David is in the house of Ahimelech.”
Why does the mighty man boast of lawlessness in his wickedness?
All day long he plotted injustice with his tongue; like a sharp razor, he sharpened his deceit.
He loved evil more than good, lawlessness more than words of righteousness.
He loved every destructive word and deceitful tongues.
For this reason God will destroy him completely; he will tear him away and remove him from his dwellings, and uproot him from the land of the living.
The righteous will see and be afraid; they will laugh at him and say:
“This is the man who did not make God his helper, but trusted in his great wealth and grew strong in his own worthlessness.”
But I am like a fruitful olive tree in the house of God. I have trusted in the mercy of God forever and for ever and ever.
I will give thanks to you forever, because you have acted; I will wait for your name, because it is good in the presence of your holy ones.
For the end. Concerning Mahalath. An instruction of David.
The fool said in his heart, “There is no God.”
They became corrupt and defiled in their lawlessness, and there is no one who does good.
God looked down from heaven upon all the children of humankind to see whether there was anyone wise who sought God.
They all turned aside together and became worthless. There is no one who does good, not even one.
How can all those who practice lawlessness fail to understand—those who devoured my people as they would eat bread, and did not call upon God?
There they will fear where there is nothing to fear, because God will scatter the bones of those who seek to please people. They will be ashamed and put to shame, because God has rejected them.
Oh, that salvation for Israel would come from Zion! When the Lord restores the captivity of his people, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.
For the end. With praises. An instruction of David.
When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Look, David is hiding among us.”
God, save me by your name, and vindicate me by your power.
God, hear my prayers; listen to the words of my mouth.
Strangers rose up against me, and mighty men sought my life; they did not keep you, God, before them.
Look, God is my helper, and the Lord is the upholder of my soul.
As you turn evil back upon my enemies, destroy them in your truth.
I will willingly offer sacrifices to you; I will give thanks to your name, Lord, for it is good.
You rescued me from all my distress, and my eye looked upon my enemies.
For the director, with hymns. For understanding. A psalm of David.
Listen, God, to my prayers, and do not disregard my requests.
Look upon me and hear me, for I grew sad in my weariness and was troubled
by the enemy’s voice and the sinner’s oppression. They turned against me unjustly; in anger they held grudges against me.
My heart was troubled within me, and the fear of death fell upon me.
Terror and trembling came upon me, and darkness covered me.
I said, “If only someone would give me wings like a dove’s, so that I could fly away!
I would go far away and rest in the wilderness.
I looked to God, who would rescue me from impatience, from anger, and from storm-tossed anguish.”
Engulf them, Lord, and divide their tongues, for I saw lawlessness and strife in the city.
Day and night they went around its walls; lawlessness, evils, and sins are within it.
Usury and deceit never ceased in its public squares.
For if an enemy had insulted me, I could have endured it; or if someone who hated me had boasted against me, I could have hidden from him.
But you, a man equal to me, my guide and my acquaintance—
indeed, you made food sweet for me and for yourself together, for we went in unity to the house of God.
Let death come upon them, and let them descend alive into the underworld, for evil is in their dwelling and among them.
I cried out to God, and the Lord heard me.
In the evening, in the morning, and at midday I recounted my troubles and spoke, and he will hear my voice.
He will rescue my soul in peace from those who draw near me, for they came against me with force.
God, who is before the ages, will hear and humble them, for there was no change in them, and they did not fear God.
